svg.title: Which tool tests which piece of a Next.js app
svg.desc: Three rows. Vitest with jsdom tests Client Components, hooks, and pure code, like review-form.tsx and nav-link.tsx, in milliseconds. Vitest in the node environment tests server code called as plain functions, like the Server Actions in actions.ts and the modules in lib. Playwright, in a real browser against the built app, tests async Server Components and whole journeys, like page.tsx and proxy.ts. Each row down is slower and proves more.
svg.text: Vitest + jsdom milliseconds, a fake DOM
Client Components, hooks, pure code review-form.tsx, nav-link.tsx
Vitest + node server code as functions
Server Actions, server modules actions.ts, lib/api.ts
Playwright a real browser, the build
Async Server Components, journeys page.tsx, proxy.ts, streaming
Each row down is slower, and proves more.
